coordinates.datumEvidence: Collection-level expected datum only; original tile metadata and transformation logs were not retained with this cache.
coordinates.units: UTM grid metres; elevations in source vertical datum metres

limitations: Immutable input is a previously resampled and quantized grid, not the original survey raster.
No independent surveyed checkpoints or dataset-specific accuracy certificate are bundled.
Acquisition epoch, datum realization, original tile hashes and any nodata-fill mask need recovery before survey acceptance.
Copernicus GLO-30 is a 30 m surface model, not a survey of bare-earth terrain or current snow.
UTM grid distances have projection scale distortion; no claim of exact ground-distance scale.
Catmull-Rom interpolation and render mesh LOD can deviate from measured ground between samples.
OSM positions, widths, forest planting and landmark dimensions are not independently surveyed.
No snow-depth survey; this represents source ground/surface elevations, not measured current snow.
